name: General Jarkeld
description: A general known as the Arctic Fox.

description_citations.work: Masters Edition III: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Masters Edition III: card flavor text (Masters Edition III, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: General Jarkeld meets his end rallying troops; 'last words' urge standing their ground.
timeline.quote: "Stand your ground, troops! This shall be our finest hour!"

citation.text: Rally (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Halvor Arenson asks that Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes, be remembered.
timeline.quote: "Let us remember brave Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes so long ago."

citation.text: Lost Order of Jarkeld (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: General Jarkeld disappears in the Adarkar Wastes and is believed to have perished.
timeline.quote: disappeared in the Adarkar Wastes and is believed to have perished there
